arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import os
tot=0; n=0
for base,dirs,names in os.walk('src'):
    for name in names+dirs:
        p=os.path.join(base,name); st=os.lstat(p); n+=1
        if os.path.isfile(p): tot+=st.st_size
        assert st.st_nlink==1 and os.path.isfile(p), (p, st.st_mode, st.st_nlink)
        open(p,'rb').read().decode('utf-8')
print('entries(excl root):', n-0, 'bytes:', tot)
"
